text:
Noah Dobson has gone 24 games without a goal in his second season in Montreal, and The Hockey Writers has already written that he has yet to meet expectations. Sportsnet said the Canadiens need more from him. Some of that is fair and some of it isn't.

The unfair part is the luck. He has 3.1 expected goals on his own shots (expected goals measure the quality of chances) and none have gone in, and Montreal has scored about nine fewer goals than its chances with him on the ice. His nine assists should be more. The fair part is defense: Evolving-Hockey had opponents creating more with him on last season than against all but 5% of defensemen, and he plays tough minutes. He shoots a lot, mostly from outside, by Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking. At five on five Montreal is about even with him on. Our range has him around 38 points. The first goal will help him more than anyone.
